title: 第二十一章 预选赛第二十二章 纯属扯淡
lines: “阿昊，从现在开始，你要换个名字，以我真传弟子的身份行走帝都。”
万里山河之上，任百川驾驭祥云，三人屹立于云上，风驰电掣。
“好，从现在开始，我就叫……天宝。”
林昊道，他自天宝城而来，那便以天宝为名。
“帝都的水很深，到了那里，万事不可冲动，尤其是不能打架，你一动手，别人就会怀疑你的身份，凌家的人可不傻，稍微露出马脚，我们都保不住你。”
易扶摇特意出言提醒。
林昊点头，他虽勇，却也不是四肢发达的莽夫，凌族已经放话，不允许他活着踏入帝都半步，如今他踏入帝都，若暴露身份，等待他的，就是凌族的屠刀。
说话间，一道身影出现在前方不远处，挡住了三人的去路，来人一脸的慈祥，正是西门先生。
“见过西门先生。”
林昊和任百川抱拳施礼。
无论是任百川还是西门先生，林昊都打心眼里尊敬，三天前凌族高手暗访太玄宗，以利益相诱，西门先生坚定的保自己，这份情谊，林昊并没有忘。
他自小被亲身父亲所弃，却生活在一个林家这个让他温暖的环境中，如今踏上修行路，敌人强大不可敌，亡他之心不死。
好在，他之所遇，亦有良人。
或许他们只是把自己当成了振兴太玄宗的希望，但却在用实际行动让他感受到不一样的情义。
有他们在，林昊的心，并不会彻底的冷。
“先生，出现在此，是有要交代的事情吗？”
易扶摇问道。
“扶摇，你随我回去。”
西门先生看着易扶摇，依旧是慈祥的口吻。
“为什么？”
易扶摇眉尖若蹙。
“我想了想，你还是不要跟去的好，你若出现帝都，怕是会引起不必要的麻烦，别忘了你另外一重身份，一个能让你亲自出现在帝都陪着的人，稍微聪明点的人都会怀疑阿昊的身份，何况，帝都聪明的人，有很多。”
西门先生说道：“我前两天没考虑到这一点，是我的疏忽。”
“可是，我若去了，可应付一些突发状况。”
易扶摇道。
“你若不去，可能不会有什么突发状况，没人见过他，只要他自己不作死，就不会有人怀疑。”
西门先生道：“行了，就这么决定，你跟我回去吧，百宗大比近在迟尺，你爹不在，你这个代理掌门要是也走了，太玄宗可就一盘散沙了，毕竟，宗门刚刚升起了一些斗志。”
“圣女，我觉得，西门先生说的有道理。”
任百川点头道。
“好吧，我不去了。”
易扶摇叹息一声，看向任百川：“任长老，他就交给你了，保护好。”
“圣女放心。”
任百川揪着自己的白胡子担保。
易扶摇跟着西门先生半路返回了，他们之间的对话，听的林昊云里雾里，不知所以。
“还是西门先生考虑的周到，我就没想到这一点，差一点坏事。”
看着二人远去的身影，任百川唏嘘不已。
“啥意思？”
林昊挠头：“圣女另一重身份是啥？为啥她去帝都反而会给我们带来麻烦？”
“别看她只是跃上了七丈龙门，但修行速度可以和九丈龙门上那几个比肩，圣女是唯一一个，大夏学宫永远为她保留高级弟子名额的天才。”
任百川道。
“所以，圣女为何不去大夏学宫？”
林昊不解。
“其中缘由，不好说，以后你会知道，你只要知道，她在帝都那边，名声不小，她若出现，便是主角，你说会不会引起一系列麻烦。”
任百川解释道：“而且，圣女几乎没怎么去过帝都，再加上她本身不是炼丹师，却因为一次丹阁的交流会而陪着我们一同出现，聪明人都会怀疑你的身份，如今的太玄宗，能让圣女易扶摇重视到亲自陪同的少年，除了那个跃上十丈龙门的侯门弃子，还能有谁。”
content_en:
"Ahao, from now on, you have to change your name and walk around the imperial capital as my true disciple."
Atop thousands of miles of mountains and rivers, letting hundreds of rivers control the auspicious clouds, the three of them stand on the clouds, speeding like lightning.
"Okay, from now on, my name will be... Tianbao."
Lin Hao said, since he came from Tianbao City, he was named Tianbao.
"The water in the Imperial Capital is very deep. When you get there, don't do anything impulsive, especially fights. If you make a move, others will doubt your identity. People from the Ling family are not stupid. We can't protect you even if you reveal your flaws even a little bit."
Yi Fuyao specially reminded him.
Lin Hao nodded. Although he was brave, he was not a reckless man with strong limbs. The Ling clan had already promised that he would not be allowed to step into the imperial capital alive. Now that he steps into the imperial capital, if his identity is exposed, what awaits him is the Ling clan's butcher knife.
While they were talking, a figure appeared not far ahead, blocking the path of the three of them. The person with a kind face was none other than Mr. Ximen.
"I've met Mr. Simon."
Lin Hao and Ren Baichuan clasped their fists and saluted.
Whether it was Ren Baichuan or Mr. Ximen, Lin Hao respected him from the bottom of his heart. Three days ago, the masters of the Ling clan secretly visited Taixuan Zong and offered benefits. Mr. Ximen firmly protected himself. Lin Hao has not forgotten this friendship.
He was abandoned by his own father since he was a child, but he lived in a warm environment of the Lin family. Now that he is on the path of spiritual practice, his enemies are powerful and invincible, and his desire to kill him will never die.
Fortunately, he met some good people.
Maybe they just regarded themselves as the hope of revitalizing Taixuan Sect, but they were using practical actions to make him feel a different sense of friendship.
With them here, Lin Hao's heart would not be completely cold.
"Sir, do you have something to explain when you appear here?"
Yi Fuyao asked.
"Fuyao, come back with me."
Mr. Ximen looked at Yi Fuyao, his tone still kind.
"Why?"
Yi Fuyao frowned.
"I thought about it and decided that you'd better not follow him. If you show up in the Imperial City, I'm afraid it will cause unnecessary trouble. Don't forget your other identity, a person who allows you to appear in the Imperial City in person to accompany him. Anyone who is a little smarter will doubt Ahao's identity. Besides, there are many smart people in the Imperial City."
Mr. Simon said: "I didn't consider this two days ago. It was my negligence."
"But if I go, I can deal with some emergencies."
Yi Fuyao said.
"If you don't go, there may not be any emergencies. No one has seen him. As long as he doesn't commit suicide, no one will doubt him."
Mr. Ximen said: "Okay, that's it. You come back with me. The Hundred Sect Competition is approaching in Chi Chi. Your father is not here. If you, the acting head, also leave, the Taixuan Sect will be in disarray. After all, the sect has just gained some fighting spirit."
"Holy girl, I think Mr. Simon is right."
Ren Baichuan nodded.
"Okay, I'm not going."
Yi Fuyao sighed and looked at Ren Baichuan: "Elder Ren, I will leave him to you. Protect him."
"Saint, don't worry."
Ren Baichuan grabbed his white beard and assured him.
Yi Fuyao followed Mr. Ximen halfway back. The conversation between them made Lin Hao confused and confused.
"Mr. Ximen was very considerate. I didn't expect this. It was almost a bad thing."
Seeing the two people walking away, Ren Baichuan sighed.
"What do you mean?"
Lin Hao scratched his head: "What is the saint's other identity? Why would her going to the imperial capital bring us trouble?"
"Although she only jumped to the Seven-foot Dragon Gate, her cultivation speed can be compared with those on the Nine-foot Dragon Gate. The Saint is the only genius who will always reserve a senior discipleship for her in Daxia Academy."
Ren Baichuan Road.
"So, why doesn't the saint go to Daxia Academy?"
Lin Hao was puzzled.
"The reason is hard to say. You will know it later. All you need to know is that she has a good reputation in the imperial capital. If she appears, she will be the protagonist. Do you think it will cause a series of troubles?"
Ren Baichuan explained: "Furthermore, the saint has rarely been to the imperial capital. In addition, she is not an alchemist herself, but she accompanied us because of an exchange meeting at the Alchemy Pavilion. Smart people will doubt your identity. Today's Taixuan Sect can make the saint Yi Fuyao pay attention to the boy who accompanied him personally. Who else can it be except the abandoned son of the Hou family who jumped onto the ten-foot-long dragon gate."
